source_review.notes: Checked RFC 5789 PATCH method and atomicity, RFC 6902 JSON Patch operation/error semantics, RFC 7396 Merge Patch null/array behavior, and RFC 9110 validators and preconditions.

notation_and_syntax.notes: State, partial application, undefined input, predicates, and atomic transition notation is defined before use with supported rendering.

numerical_recomputation.notes: The module makes no derived numerical claim.

evidence: Merge Patch null removes an object member
Merge Patch arrays replace whole values
failed atomic application leaves state s
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Patch results and all-or-none transition consequences were independently derived from the selected media-type algorithms and PATCH premise.

boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Boundary review covers format ambiguity, concurrency, atomicity, authorization, resource cost, sensitive data, and partial observation.

invariant_checking.notes: All five invariants are exercised by examples and transfer answers.

proof_review.notes: No formal implementation proof is claimed.

evidence: storage transaction is mechanism rather than document semantics
precondition is bounded to selected state
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: This conceptual and protocol module appropriately contains no artificial executable code or empirical production claim.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed PATCH versus patch media types, atomicity, Merge Patch, JSON Patch, arrays, null, schemas, preconditions, idempotency, authorization, responses, and cache effects.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed transaction scope, candidate-state validation, parser/path limits, field transitions, source disclosure, operation lookup, sensitive logging, derived-view invalidation, and offline reconciliation.

pedagogical_review.notes: Ten examples isolate distinct patch defects; five exercises progress from definitions through algorithm tracing, implementation diagnosis, design comparison, and safety-critical transfer, with complete answers.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
